title: Read token lists, generators, and parse sessions
description: You follow token production and inspect how the supplied context manager reports session exit.

steps.description: You annotate tokenize's input and returned token list. The loop appends tokens for digits, identifiers, operators, or unknown characters, then adds EOF.
You replace token appends with yield in tokenize_lazy. The consuming loop prints each token as it receives it.
You define an integer generator with an unbounded loop. take requests only the supplied number of values with next.
You create parse_session with the contextmanager decorator. It builds a token list and yields a dictionary containing tokens, position, and errors.

steps.question: Which statements run when the with body raises the supplied ValueError?
steps.answer: The exception handler records and prints the error. The finally block then prints the closing message and token-consumption count.

steps.description: You simulate complete consumption in the first session and raise an error in the second. The recorded closing messages report no errors for the first and the captured error for the second.
